OpenAI says the FBI arrested one of its staffers after the company found a hidden recording device in its offices and used its models to understand the device   —  We discovered a sophisticated recording device that was hidden inside one of our offices. We used our models to understand the device and where it had come from, identifying that a specific employee had planted it a few days earlier.
